text: The banker took the paper. <break time="0.8s" /> From the table. <break time="0.8s" /> And read it. <break time="0.8s" /> Tomorrow at twelve oclock. <break time="0.8s" /> I will be free. <break time="0.8s" /> But before I leave this room. <break time="0.8s" /> I must say a few words to you. <break time="0.8s" /> For fifteen years. <break time="0.8s" /> I have studied life on earth. <break time="0.8s" /> Through books. <break time="0.8s" /> In your books. <break time="0.8s" /> I have climbed mountains. <break time="0.8s" /> Loved beautiful women. <break time="0.8s" /> And spoken with great thinkers. <break time="0.8s" /> And now I despise. <break time="0.8s" /> All your books. <break time="0.8s" /> And I despise. <break time="0.8s" /> All the wisdom and blessings. <break time="0.8s" /> Of this world. <break time="0.8s" /> Everything is empty and false. <break time="0.8s" /> Like a dream You may be proud and wise and beautiful. <break time="0.8s" /> But death will wipe you off the earth. <break time="0.8s" /> To show you. <break time="0.8s" /> How much I despise. <break time="0.8s" /> What you live for I give up the two million. <break time="0.8s" /> I will leave here. <break time="0.8s" /> Five hours before the time. <break time="0.8s" /> And so break our agreement. <break time="0.8s" /> The banker put the paper back. <break time="0.8s" /> On the table. <break time="0.8s" /> Kissed the strange man on the head. <break time="0.8s" /> And went out of the lodge weeping. <break time="0.8s" /> Never before had he felt. <break time="0.8s" /> Such deep contempt. <break time="0.8s" /> For himself. <break time="0.8s" /> The next morning. <break time="0.8s" /> The watchman ran in and reported that the prisoner had climbed out of the window. <break time="0.8s" /> And disappeared. <break time="0.8s" /> The banker went to the lodge. <break time="0.8s" /> Took the paper. <break time="0.8s" /> And locked it in his safe.
